column2: Exactly seven separate round flat discs, like thick smooth coins with softly rounded edges, float scattered across the whole frame at different heights and different tilts, well apart from each other, none touching, most of them in the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower left of the frame is empty. Seen straight on from slightly above.

the very same discs as in the reference image, the same number of them, each one has only moved a short way closer to the others and turned a little more level, so the group is tighter and sits in the upper right of centre with two of them just overlapping. Do not add any disc and do not hide any disc: count the discs in the reference and keep that count, seven. Still floating in mid-air: no floor, no ground, no cast shadows on any surface. Same straight-on view from slightly above.

the same seven discs are now lined up one above another in a loose, slightly leaning column in the upper right of centre, each disc nearly level, with uneven gaps of air between them. Nothing added, nothing removed, still exactly seven discs.

the same seven floating discs have settled into one neat disc stack that is seven discs tall, in the upper right of centre: one top face showing and seven separate rims counted from top to bottom, every disc level and directly above the one below, a small even gap of air between each. Still floating in mid-air: no floor, no ground, no cast shadow below. Nothing added, nothing removed. The lower left of the frame stays empty.
